findings.prior_boundary: S2-V56-A01/A04/A05/A06 and B D-02: watchdog identity, cancellation and total finish bound
findings.title: Parent-identity guard examines BASHPID inside a command substitution, not the watchdog/alarm shell
findings.counterexample: At D211, BASHPID is expanded inside $(ps ... | tr ...), so it denotes a shell in that command-substitution/pipeline execution, not the outer watchdog whose parent must equal DRIVER_PID; the queried parent is therefore a nested shell rather than the driver, or the lookup fails, and wd_parent_ok returns false before D214 on an ordinary live-driver path. [Driver L209-L218](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L209)
findings.consequence: The watchdog exits at its first guard without the required TERM, KILL or driver-cancellation stages, so W1/N7 cannot satisfy their watchdog assertions and C1/N8 cannot prove cancellation; the identical BASHPID expression in the finish alarm disables its driver-KILL branch as well, leaving the claimed total-tail bound unestablished. [Driver L154-L158](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L154) [W1/C1 L365-L386](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L365) [N7/N8 L454-L467](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L454)
findings.smallest_correction: Capture each actual watchdog/alarm shell's BASHPID in that shell before entering command substitution, and query that stable captured pid's parent; retain the parent-alive guard and existing W1/C1/N7/N8 assertions, not weaker substitutes.
findings.evidence_class: Static shell-semantics counterexample; no reproduction or probe executed

findings.prior_boundary: S2-V56-A04 historical PID reacquisition remains materially open
findings.title: Import-time starttime and sleep shape do not bind a historical PID to its original spawned process
findings.counterexample: After a logged spawned pid has died, let that number be reused before record_from_run by an unrelated sleep 30 launched after this driver started; D84 accepts liveness, D85 accepts its post-T0 start, D86 accepts its command shape, and D87 snapshots the replacement's own starttime as a new owned record rather than comparing against an identity captured when the original child was owned. [Driver L70-L87](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L70) [Import occurs after runner returns, L188-L189](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L188)
findings.consequence: rec_alive then validates that newly captured replacement starttime and owned_cleanup can TERM/KILL the unrelated process; the new record format protects against reuse after import, but not the prior finding's reuse before import. [Driver L75,L129-L134](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L129) [Prior A04](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/audits/s2-v56-a/AUDIT.json#L48)
findings.smallest_correction: Preserve provenance from actual ownership acquisition for these imports, or refuse to promote an unprovable historical number into signal authority; do not use post-T0 plus a common sleep name as a substitute for that binding.
findings.evidence_class: Specific reuse schedule at the already-open historical-import boundary; not a claim that PID reuse was observed and not an arbitrary-setsid containment requirement

findings.title: N4's decoy remains unowned during its deliberate pre-registration sleep
findings.counterexample: Deliver TERM to the driver after N4 starts the 60-second caller-group decoy at D394 and during its sleep 0.2, before D395 appends the pid record to CTRL; on_cancel enters finish without reaching that registration, PENDING_ENC is not a controller latch, and neither registry contains this decoy. [N4 L393-L396](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L393) [Cancellation/finally L115-L128,L161-L174](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L161)
findings.consequence: The decoy is deliberately outside PAT, so both controller census and the final detected-survivor gate can report empty while it survives the cancelled driver; adding a finally registry only after the acknowledgement delay does not close the prior cancellation boundary. [Pattern L66](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L66) [Census and gate L123-L128,L163-L166](file:///home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s2-v57/controls-proposed/run-controls-v57.sh#L123)
findings.smallest_correction: Make acquisition of this controller child interruption-safe before the readiness wait, and have finally resolve any pending controller acquisition; keep it excluded from tested owned-work cleanup while retained by its controller's cancellation path.
findings.evidence_class: Concrete signal schedule in the existing 0.2-second window, not a new broad fault-coverage project
